applicationContractAfterApproval.target: Tagged immutable Admin/Costing candidate revisions while the seven existing services retain stable traffic
applicationContractAfterApproval.idsAndCodes: Resolve fresh IDs and authoritative codes from owner API responses; logical keys above are not database IDs. Never copy IDs or code sequence counters from Local.
applicationContractAfterApproval.idempotency: Persist an execution manifest per approved plan hash, tenant, logical key, command key and authenticated actor; retries of the same command use the same key and must not create a second entity.
applicationContractAfterApproval.scopes: Preserve existing membership/role semantics. Record existing wildcard scopes at baseline: these already include future divisions under current application rules, so their holders may see newly created divisions without a metadata edit. Review that visibility before applying. Do not create new wildcard grants. Any change for a named tester requires an explicit membership ID and exact division grant in the final approved manifest.
applicationContractAfterApproval.currencies: Confirm the proposed MXN/USD and every other active existing Society explicitly. Resolve actual IDs before setting QA_CONFIRMED_SOCIETY_CURRENCIES; no implicit importer defaults.
applicationContractAfterApproval.preTrafficGate: check_qa_operational_readiness.py must pass with exact tenant, reviewed currencies, active organization, resolvable scopes and existing authorized operational owner. Failure prevents promotion of stable traffic.

operationalAcceptanceBoundary.existingMasters: Inventory warehouses/items, Production machines/products/recipes, HR positions/workers and commercial assignments must be inspected before acceptance. Missing division/currency provenance requires an explicitly reviewed mapping or separately approved synthetic fixture; never assign existing records by guessing.
operationalAcceptanceBoundary.followupManifest: Before any QA operational UAT, declare exact owner APIs, dedicated logical fixture keys, quantities, costs/rates, actors/scopes and cleanup. Operational documents, stock movements and master data are not authorized by approval of this organization-only plan.
operationalAcceptanceBoundary.acceptance: Compare enabled capabilities and run authenticated positive/negative/retry/persistence cases against QA. Retain separate blocked variants for historical CC-19 provenance and unauthorized second-tenant isolation; do not mark QA parity from schema, smoke or this structure alone.

preservation: No Local database export, copy or seed execution in QA
No alteration or assignment of existing masters, documents, stock, costs, rates or monetary history
No reset of tenant profile, users, memberships, custom roles, module entitlements or code sequences
No activation of analytical Costing or Accounting
Do not equate synthetic acceptance with certification of historical records lacking CC-19 provenance
cleanupAndRollback: Keep the exact created IDs and audit. Before use, deactivate only the new centers/divisions/societies/issuer in dependency order if rollback is approved. After operational use preserve immutable documents and history; do not delete rows, rewind codes or downgrade schema. Restore only explicitly changed tester scopes from their recorded prior revisions.
